Publishing uploads four artifacts without automatic remote rollback.
Simulator skip-build still installs/launches; preserve artifacts without enabling execution.
Device skip-build/open-Xcode branches retain explicit installation and launch boundaries.
ASC validation and local env/contact metadata must not enter ordinary logs or migration.
